snippet.title: Hamburger Hill | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Hamburger Hill on itch.io:
https://weswaregames.itch.io/hamburger-hill

Lead your squad through the jungles, rice paddies and streets of Granovia in a single-player military FPS. Plan your campaign, equip your soldiers, then fight each battle yourself.

Three factions. Airborne invasions. Beach landings. Jungle patrols and massive battles.

Developed by Wesware Games.
